posts.title: CyberSongs & Braindogs
posts.description: --> A mysterious stranger gave away this disk at a zinefest in Wisconsin. I brought it to a retro computer museum show, where a Wisconsin Computer Club ber named Jamie kindly greaseweazled it for me. My friend Lynn recovered the data with me. It contains songs for MacroMind MusicWorks, a music composition program from 1985. Converted to mp3 by recording a Macintosh SE emulator: disk recovery nitty

posts.title: opossums are possums
posts.description: Some List Animals Until Failure players tell me American opossums are not possums, and Australasian possums are not opossums; in other words, possums live in America, opossums live in Australasia. However, according to Wikipedia (the game's source of truth) opossums are possums. A paragraph in the gameover screen explains this. But maybe what you need isn't a paragraph. Maybe you need an example.
